title: Design Patterns
objectives: Group patterns into creational, structural, behavioral
Recognize Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy, Decorator
Apply a pattern only when it removes real pain

sections.markdown: Design patterns are reusable, named solutions to recurring design problems (Gang of Four). They're a shared vocabulary — 'use a Factory here' communicates a whole design in two words.
Overusing Singletons — they're global state in disguise, hurt testability, and cause threading bugs. Prefer injecting one instance over a hard Singleton.
Patterns are tools, not goals. Reach for one only when it removes real duplication or coupling. Name the pattern after recognizing the problem, not before.

flashcards.back: Observer — a subject notifies many observers (Streams, BLoC, ChangeNotifier, RxJS).
Encapsulate interchangeable algorithms behind a common interface and swap them at runtime.

quiz.q: Observer pattern is the basis of…
quiz.explain: Streams, BLoC and ChangeNotifier all notify observers of state changes.
Singletons are hidden global state and make tests harder; prefer DI.

quiz.q: Which family does Factory belong to?
quiz.explain: Factory is a creational pattern — it's about how objects are created.
